newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close up, food scrips lead gains.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close up, food scrips lead gains.

text.p: Heavy gains by food scrips helped Dhaka stocks to sustain a market rally by offsetting losses by some weighted shares, brokers said.

Brokers said Amam Sea Food rose by 5,780 taka to 16,733.33, a record single session gain by any scrip, as it was exempted from price movement limit after the company announced one for one bonus share. Dhaka Stock Exchange index rose 62.65 points or 2.85 percent at 2,326.51 on a tunrover of 385.6 million taka.
Of the 113 issues traded, 64 gained, 44 lost and five unchanged. IDLC gained 700 taka to 7,708, Apex Foods rose 524.11 to 17,628.79 and Bangladesh Tobacco shed 20.69 to 327.64.
